Move on @Aptos  stands out because it doesn’t rely on testing alone.

With the Move Specification Language (MSL), developers can define exactly how smart contracts should behave, when they should fail, and what conditions must always remain true.

Then the Move Prover mathematically verifies the code across all possible states and inputs.

Not just writing smart contracts.
Writing guarantees.
